name: File Explorer Plugin
description: Recursive file tree browser. Reads directory via fs:readDir IPC, sorts directories first. Expand/collapse with arrow indicators (▸/▾). Color-coded file icons by extension: blue for TS/JS, purple for CSS, amber for JSON/YAML, green for MD. Right-click context menus: directories (New File, New Folder, Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete), files (Copy, Paste, Rename, Delete, plus 'Open to Markdown' for .md files). Inline input for instant file/folder creation and rename (Enter commits, Escape cancels, blur commits). Copy/paste with _copy_N auto-naming (prevents overwrites). Delete confirmation via ConfirmModal. External file change watching via fs:onChanged (500ms debounced refresh). Wheel event stopPropagation to prevent canvas zoom. Tracks selected path for visual highlight.

dependencies.usage: Right-click context menus on files and directories
